tasks.name: detail-watch-progress-api
tasks.summary: Added one approved development DB watch-progress fixture for the admin on episode 00000004-0000-4000-8000-000000000003 (position 0, incomplete). HTTP returns the record only for that user; another user and omitted user receive null. Updated Postman defaults and README fixture setup. Passed lint, test (68 unit tests and 42 API requests/128 assertions), and build.

tasks.name: detail-watch-progress-colors
tasks.summary: Added the nullable watchProgress contract to DramaContent. Episode tiles use the accent background only when progress exists, including zero-position incomplete records; the free label always uses muted. Updated existing content and screen tests for watched/unwatched free and paid episodes. Passed typecheck, all 30 frontend tests, and Expo export.
